confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and the two meal anchors rest on aggregated Numbeo-derived figures and expat or budget sites, partly from one neighborhood (El Coco) and secondary blog summaries, so they are medium quality. Cocktail and wine_glass are low confidence: no restaurant-price source was found. Cocktail uses an Expatistan club figure of about 11 balboas (balboa is USD-pegged) cross-checked against beer, roughly 3.3x. Wine_glass uses about 2.5x the beer anchor because the only wine figure found is a retail bottle price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation search was performed and they should be treated as low confidence. The FX value is the RBA-attributed 15 October 2026 observation as surfaced in search (RBA homepage text). It was not independently confirmed against the F11.1 table, and a later secondary figure for 16 October was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are city-specific, from the sources above. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for a dollarised, tourism-oriented Latin American capital, with no comparable-city search performed. Drink relativities to beer are used for cocktail and wine_glass as disclosed above.
